data.name: Abinus
data.gender_notes: Abinus is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Abinus is a combination of two Arabic words: Abi (Father) and Us (Noble One). It is an honorable name for a boy, signifying that he is the father of a noble child. The name Abinus carries the meaning “Father of Noble One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, English. Parents who choose Abinus usually hope their child will grow to embody father of noble one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Abinus is a name that inspires a deep sense of responsibility and love. It encourages the bearer to be a nurturing and supportive father figure, not only to his own children, but to all those around him. It also symbolizes the wisdom and intelligence that comes with experience and age.
data.etymology: Abinus belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of Noble One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abinus total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: @ابينوس
in_arabic.meaning: ابينوس مزيج من الابن العزيز والفضل
in_arabic.long_meaning: ابينوس هو اسم عربي مشتق من كلمتين فضل والابن، ويستخدم في بعض الأحيان للإشارة إلى الفضل المكتسب أو الابن المفضل. وفقًا للقانون الوقف في الفقه الإسلامي، فإن الوقف هو إبقاء مال أو أملاك على حالها، ويسمى الواقف بالابن، ويسمى الموقوف بالفضل. هذا يعني أن الابن هو الذي يوقف الأموال أو الأصول، وبالتالي فهو مكتسب للفضل. وفي بعض الأحيان، يُستخدم اسم ابينوس للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي له الفضل المكتسب من خلال إنجازاته أو إحسانه.

in_urdu.name: ابینوس

in_urdu.long_meaning: ابینوس نام ایک مشتق نام ہے جو فضل اور ابن دونوں کے نام سے ملتا ہے۔ یہ نام کچھ اوقات فضل حاصل یا پسندیدہ بیٹا کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔ فقہ اسلامی میں قانون وقف کے مطابق، وقف کسی مال یا املاک کا ایسا بنانا ہوتا ہے جسے کسی بھی چیز کا استعمال نہیں کیا جاسکتا، اور اسے وقف کے نام سے پکارتے ہیں۔ وقف کا مالدار وقف کہلاتا ہے، اور وقف کے مال کو فضل کہتے ہیں۔ مزید برآں، وقف اور فضل دونوں کے مالدار کو ایک ہی نام سے پکایا جاتا ہے، جسے ابینوس کہتے ہیں۔

in_english.name: Abinus
in_english.meaning: Abinus is a balanced name between favor and child
in_english.long_meaning: Abinus is a name derived from the Arabic roots of favor and child. In Islamic tradition, favor refers to the merit or favor earned through good deeds, and child refers to the offspring or progeny. Abinus is sometimes used to signify the balance between favor and child, indicating a person who has earned favor through their actions or has a favored child. In Islamic jurisprudence, the concept of waqf refers to the act of preserving a property or asset, and the person who undertakes this act is called the waqif, while the preserved property is called the faydal. Therefore, Abinus is often used to denote a person who has earned favor through their actions, or has a favored child, indicating a balance between the two concepts.
